target_customer: Software teams shipping code with coding agents that need automated end-to-end verification of web and mobile apps
problem: As coding agents write more code, teams need a way to prove the software works; manual QA and brittle test scripts do not keep up.
business_model: Open-source (Apache-2.0) testing framework with a planned paid cloud product (e2e cloud, planned 2027)
product_category: AI end-to-end testing and software verification

founders.name: Szymon Rybczak
founders.background_notes: YC page says he became the youngest contributor to React Native at 16 and maintains open-source libraries.

founders.name: Oskar Kwaśniewski
education: Computer science in Poland (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: React Native core contributor per YC page.

competitors.name: Autosana
competitors.what: Agentic platform for mobile and web UI testing

competitors.name: smoothQA
competitors.what: AI agents that navigate and validate web apps

competitors.name: AgenQA
competitors.what: Natural language to end-to-end web tests

technical_complexity.rationale: Driving real browsers, iOS simulators and Android emulators with agents, plus step caching for replay without model calls, is solid engineering but built on existing models and tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI testing entrants; open source licensing lowers lock in, though tests stored in customer repos create some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents launched agentic testing products during 2026; no acquisition of e2e found.

market_need_then: Industry commentary and 2026 product launches describe verification as the bottleneck as coding agents write more code.

branding.domain_note: Owns the exact e2e.com domain; acquisition history not found

identity.visual_style: code example led product page, lowercase name

rebrands.why: Closed hosted platform replaced by open-source framework where tests live with customer code (per press summary)

brand_strength.rationale: Short exact match domain but the name is a generic testing term; press about the brand is limited to funding news.

pivots.from: TesterArmy closed hosted AI QA agent platform
pivots.to: open-source e2e testing framework with cloud planned for 2027
pivots.why: Customers could not keep tests alongside their code (per press summary); old platform sunsets 2027-01-15

outcome_analysis: e2e began as TesterArmy in early 2026, raised a pre-seed in September and an 8 million dollar seed in November 2026 after rebranding and moving to open source. The founders are known open-source React Native contributors, which helped fundraising speed. Crowded AI testing competition is the main risk. No exit exists.
notes: Seed reported as EUR 7M or USD 8M by different outlets; pre-seed reported as EUR 1.04M or 1.05M (USD 1.2M), dated 2026-09-15 by its article while the seed article says three months earlier. Launch date and batch (Spring 2026) from YC page.
